strings.zh: 最近很多黑暗洞穴中的精灵{NEWLINE}跑到了这附近来,{CLEAR}我猜可能是洞穴中发生了异变。{CLEAR}真是让人担心啊。
strings.en: Lately, lots of Pokémon from Dark{NEWLINE}Cave have been wandering around here.{CLEAR}Maybe something strange is going on{CLEAR}inside the cave. It’s really worrying.

strings.zh: 黑暗洞穴的异变好像解除了,{NEWLINE}这样我也能安心地帮助{CLEAR}路过的训练家们了。
strings.en: Looks like whatever was wrong{NEWLINE}in Dark Cave has cleared up. Now I{CLEAR}can go back to helping the Trainers{CLEAR}who pass by without worrying.

strings.zh: 你是第一次来城都地区吧？{NEWLINE}有没有时间回答我几个问题,{CLEAR}让我看看你对训练家的事了解多少。{SCROLL}要回答精灵爷爷的提问吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Is this your first time in Johto?{NEWLINE}Do you have time to answer a few{CLEAR}questions? Let’s see how much{CLEAR}you know about being a Trainer.{SCROLL}Answer Mr. Pokémon’s questions?{SCROLL}
strings.notes: Mr. Pokémon's quiz #3–#27; the correct answers aren't visible in the text (likely 100 / Focus Punch / Slaking / Forretress / Attack and Speed).

不错,能答对这些问题,{NEWLINE}说明你对口袋妖怪了解得非常深刻。{CLEAR}能遇到你这样优秀的年轻训练家,{CLEAR}爷爷我很是欣慰。{SCROLL}这个就送给你吧,希望你能再接再厉,{NEWLINE}变得比现在更加出色。
strings.en: Well done! Getting all those right{NEWLINE}shows you really know your Pokémon.{CLEAR}It warms this old man’s heart to{CLEAR}meet a fine young Trainer like you.{SCROLL}Please take this. Keep up the{NEWLINE}good work and become even{CLEAR}better than you are now.

strings.zh: 获得升龙徽章后,{NEWLINE}就可以在战斗外使出攀岩了。{CLEAR}试着爬上那些有落脚点的岩壁,{CLEAR}你或许会有新的发现哦。
strings.en: Once you have the Rising Badge, you{NEWLINE}can use Rock Climb outside of battle.{CLEAR}Try climbing rocky walls with footholds.{CLEAR}You might discover something new!

strings.zh: 从没见过的硬币{NEWLINE}散落了一地！{CLEAR}是什么国家的钱币呢？
strings.en: Coins you’ve never seen before are{NEWLINE}scattered all over! What country could{CLEAR}they be from?
